slot_note: Architecture 4, a re-root out of political-science-public-policy into energy-systems-utilities (grid-reliability-outage-analysis), drawn after the 2026-11-04 pass that screened 55 candidates (A4.1 to A4.55 in the design note) and the coordinator's order to draw in the cells the window had just opened. Architecture 3 (a classifier corrected by hand-coded audits) is spent and sits in the lineage. New client domain, world, dataset, generator and prompt shell; no seed mechanism used.
niche: a city-owned electric utility sending its one overhead line patrol crew for the week to the distribution feeder where a component is failing, read from the feeder head relays' fault records, when one cracked insulator flashes over on damp mornings and clears each time the breaker recloses
analyst_test: A strong analyst who joins the relay records to the SCADA operations, groups reclosing operations into momentary interruption events, sets aside the storm days the lightning and wind records mark, normalises by overhead line length and compares August to October 2026 with the same months of 2025 sends the patrol to a feeder whose blinks are storms, squirrels or line exposure, when the feeder with a failing component is the one whose faults keep returning at one recorded current on one phase.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is where on the network a component is breaking down, which distribution protection reads from the fault current each operation records, because the current a fault draws falls with its distance from the substation through the feeder's impedance, so one insulator flashing over again and again records one current on one phase; with another field's nouns there is no feeder impedance, no fault current, no flashover that clears when the breaker recloses and no momentary interruption to count.
layer1: head-breaker relay fault records in UTC against the SCADA sequence-of-events log in local time, the same operation in both
reclosing shots within five minutes forming one momentary interruption event
mid-line recloser logs in kiloamps against the relays' amps, and phase labels in two conventions
OMS outage tickets in two layouts across the 2025 to 2026 system upgrade, with partial restorations as child tickets
the device register's customer counts downstream of each device, and feeders renumbered at a substation rebuild
lightning strokes and hourly weather in UTC, the storm-day screen on local calendar days
stakeholder_role: the utility's distribution reliability engineer, who assigns the overhead line patrol crew each week

spine.entity: one cloud-to-ground lightning stroke in the service territory's box

world.geography: United States (a fictional city in Missouri)

driver: The decisive quantity is where a unit's repeated failures come from, and the record places each failure only through a measured signature that falls with distance along the unit, so one point failing again and again shows as several events sharing one signature, while every count of events, with or without the weather, per unit length or against last year, ranks first the unit with the most independent events.
driver_concrete: Each feeder's momentary faults are grouped by faulted phase and the fault current its head relay recorded, because a cracked insulator flashing over on damp mornings draws the same current on the same phase every time, so the feeder with a failing component is the one whose faults return at one current, not the one with the most momentary events, the most outside storm days, the most per mile or the biggest rise on 2025.
stump: A competent solver counts each feeder's momentary interruption events for August to October 2026, sets aside storm days, normalises by overhead miles and sets the result against 2025, and sends the patrol to a feeder whose blinks are storms, squirrels or exposure, when the feeder whose faults repeat at one current on one phase has an insulator failing.

differentiation.task311: task311 splits a survey's variance between groups and the units within them to price added interviews; here nothing about variance is estimated: each feeder's momentary faults are grouped by the phase and fault current each operation recorded, and one failing insulator shows as several operations at one current.
differentiation.task65: task65 constitutes capped entities from child records by the child's own location for a fee; here no total is capped or constituted: each protective operation is placed at a point on its feeder by the current it recorded, and the call is the feeder where one point keeps failing.
differentiation.task84: task84 groups an advertiser's live campaigns on a composite target key to price their competition; here the grouping key is physical, the recorded fault current and phase, and the repeated group is one failing component, not competing copies.
differentiation.task183: task183 forecasts next year's cable failures from each section's own recorded failure history, sections known by their ids; here no part is identified in any record: the failing insulator is found only because its flashovers record one current on one phase, and the call is where to patrol now, not a forward count.
differentiation.task194: task194 nets one metered area's night-flow rise against a neighbour's simultaneous fall through an open boundary valve; here nothing passes between feeders and nothing is netted: the step is grouping one feeder's own faults by the current each recorded.
differentiation.task303: task303 removes the breaker tickets every feeder opened in the same minute as one upstream supply loss; here no event is shared across feeders: the repeated group is one feeder's faults at one current on separate damp mornings.

lineage.fate: spent, confirmed at the 2026-11-01 re-check (commit 91cee50) and marked architecture_spent on 2026-11-04: its seventh cell (a logistic fit of hand code on the classifier mark plus a month index, extrapolated over September and October) files 504 and prints 500 against the golden 450, and the sentence that would close it names what the decisive step recognises, so the fork is the stump; shipped 2026-10-17 (060f8959) and left at the portal, pending
lineage.niche: how many of a protest register's recorded actions were confrontational when most of the labels come from a classifier whose hand-coded validation batches only ever reached the opening of the period
lineage.driver: The decisive count is of the units that truly carry a property the record labels by instrument, where the instrument's validation batch only ever covered the opening of the observation window and the population's composition moved after it, so the quantities that carry forward are what the instrument does to a unit of a given class and never what share of the batch's units were of that class, and every stratified route has no rate for the part of the population the batch never reached.
lineage.stump: A competent solver builds the action record, reads the clause that says the count is of the actions and not of the codes, corrects the classifier's labels with the confrontational shares the hand coding found on each side of them and files 600, which carries shares measured on the audited opening of the period onto a period whose composition moved under them.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 3 on measurement 2026-10-17, before any file was cut. The default path's grouping of flagged location-days is a single-linkage clustering whose one free parameter takes the count from 673 through 65, 22 and 9 to 1: no parameter-free reading gives a plausible count and the range covers the golden, so a solver can land 9 by tuning and the note's 23 was never reproducible. Rule 1 also fails on measurement: the number of arithmetic progressions in a union of them is not a quantity conflict event analysis estimates, and the swap reads unchanged with machines on fixed maintenance cycles.
lineage.driver: The decisive count is of the distinct generating processes behind overlapping bursts, recovered from the interval each process repeats on, where counting flagged items counts the targets they share and counting flagged intervals counts their overlaps.
lineage.stump: A competent solver takes the flagged location-days, groups the ones that touch in time and place, counts the groups and files that number, which counts the overlaps of the operations rather than the operations.

lineage.fate: blocked at the draw on 2026-10-17 after the remote merge, with the pack built and every free gate green: the competing-exit mechanism had been taken the same day by task266 (own:competing-endings-cumulative-incidence), and the gap, decisive pattern and decision type repeated task157 (time, G12, quantity_figure) while the stakeholder role repeated task190 v2. The world, the ask layer and every pack writer that is not about the decisive quantity were kept.
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units of a cohort will have shown an event by the end of their own lives, and because a unit that has already reached the other, terminal end can never show it while a unit still running can, the count has to treat that other end as leaving the population at risk and the running units as the only ones with an event still to come, which is exactly what both natural corrections get wrong.
lineage.stump: A competent solver builds the register, counts the 89 episodes of the period's cohort that have already recorded a confrontational action and files that number, which counts the confrontations the record has already seen rather than the confrontations the cohort will have recorded by the time its episodes close.

notes: Architecture 4 drawn 2026-11-04 in energy-systems-utilities after task461 v2 and task193 v3 registered and task194 v17 left the last three. Axes drawn against the window: forum operations_desk (the distribution operations desk dispatches the crew; line_manager_or_team is banned against task193), forcing event shift_or_daily_cycle (the weekly crew assignment), org family local_government (a city department, not an investor-owned utility; utility_or_infrastructure is banned against task193), role family other (a reliability engineer; operations_director and field_unit_lead are banned against task461 and task193), context artifact filed_standard (the utility's distribution reliability procedure; monitoring_export and operations_log are banned against task193 and task461). Gate G decomposition_attribution: each feeder's momentary events are attributed to storms, animals, vegetation and one repeating point. stump_strategy grain_or_unit: the record's unit is a protective operation and the decision's is a failing point on a feeder, so operations are grouped into the points they came from; identity_resolution was the other honest label. Decisive generator G2 (the operation grain against the point grain), G10 second (one point's failures counted as many events). Strategy risk WARN answered by the analyst test: every field and rule read correctly still files a storm, squirrel or exposure feeder. Architecture 3 moved into the lineage with its shell.
